decisions.decision: By consensus, the Board agreed to tour the municipal buildings in August, once a full Board is seated after the election.
decisions.quote: by consensus, the board agreed to the following

decisions.decision: Request a joint meeting with the Municipal Building Design Committee in mid-to-late August for an advisory recommendation.
decisions.quote: request a joint meeting with the municipal building design committee in mid-to-late august for an advisory recommendation

decisions.decision: Chair Emkey to formally ask the committee chair to discuss and make a recommendation on demolition versus renovation.
decisions.quote: have chair emkey formally ask the committee chair to discuss and make a recommendation on demolition versus renovation

decisions.decision: Include the evaluation of the Municipal Building Design Committee's charge and composition as a goal.
decisions.quote: include the evaluation of the committee's charge and composition as a goal

decisions.decision: By consensus, the Board agreed to prepare its own Brooks House report using input from Planning Director Stephen Wallace and Facilities Director Ruth.
decisions.quote: by consensus, the board agreed to prepare its own report using input from director of planning and economic development stephen wallace

decisions.decision: Chair Emkey will draft a Brooks House goal, targeting the fall Town Meeting.
decisions.quote: chair emkey will draft a goal, with a target of the fall town meeting.

decisions.decision: Members agreed that staff and public engagement should be a goal.
decisions.quote: members agreed that staff and public engagement should be a goal.

decisions.decision: Members agreed to include the coffee-with and office-hours concept.
Members agreed to add the Master Plan as a standalone goal.
decisions.quote: members agreed to add it as a standalone goal.

decisions.decision: Members agreed that a tri-board departmental budget series like last year's is not feasible.
decisions.quote: members agreed that a tri-board departmental budget series like last year's is not feasible.

decisions.decision: Vice-Chair Lehtinen and Chair Emkey supported continued letters, resolutions, and legislative outreach as regular agenda items, not as a formal goal.
decisions.quote: vice-chair lehtinen and chair emkey supported continued letters, resolutions, and legislative outreach as regular agenda items rather than as a formal goal.

decisions.decision: Chair Emkey will compile the Board's FY27 goals into a single draft with timelines; the Board will revisit it once the full Board is seated after the election.
decisions.quote: chair emkey will compile the board's goals into a single draft with timelines. the board will revisit the draft once the full board is seated after the election.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Three shortfalls totaling $18,081.51 were presented, with the Planning Board Director's salary line proposed as the funding source.
budget_items.quote: the total was $18,081.51. the proposed funding source was the planning board director's salary line

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Board accepted a $1,065 gift from Dillis & Roy Civil Design Group for the beach house dedication sign.
budget_items.quote: acceptance of $1,065 gift from dillis & roy civil design group for beach house dedication sign

budget_items.topic: T.C. Passios building maintenance and roof
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Facilities Director Chris Ruth estimated annual maintenance cost and roof replacement cost for the remaining structure.
budget_items.quote: facilities director chris ruth estimated roughly $120,000 per year to maintain the building and about $1,000,000 for a roof on the remaining structure.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A prior capital request for asbestos abatement of the decommissioned portion was noted as a little shy of $400,000.
budget_items.quote: a prior capital request for asbestos abatement of the decommissioned portion was a little shy of $400,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager reported asking the Facilities Director for a rough estimate to renovate only the first floor and roof; no figure was printed.
budget_items.quote: she also reported that she had asked mr. ruth for a rough estimate to renovate only the first floor and roof for municipal office use.
